fields.name: OUT_GENERATE_PARAMETER_STRING
fields.expression:
--IIF(V_CHECK_HEADER = 1,
--'[' || IN_SESS_CD || ']' || chr(13)||chr(10),NULL)|| 
IN_PARM_CD || '=' ||
IIF(IN_PARM_VAL = 'SESS_ID', TO_CHAR(IN_SESS_ID),
IIF((IN_PARM_VAL = 'SESS_EXEC_ID' ), TO_CHAR(IN_SESS_EXEC_ID),
IIF(IN_PARM_VAL = 'WKF_EXEC_ID', TO_CHAR(IN_WKF_EXEC_ID),
IIF(IN_PARM_VAL = '$curr_exec_start_date', TO_CHAR(LKP_CURR_EXEC_START_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM'),
IIF(IN_PARM_VAL = '$pre_exec_start_date', TO_CHAR(LKP_PRE_EXEC_START_DATE, 'MM/DD/YYYY HH:MI:SS AM'),
 IN_PARM_VAL)))))

DESC: To fetch Start and End Time of previous successful session execution from SESS_EXEC
transformations.name: LKP_GET_PREV_SESS_STRT_END_DATE

advancedProperties.name: Lookup Sql Override
advancedProperties.value:
select se.sess_id as sess_id,max(se.sess_exec_strt_tms) as SESS_EXEC_STRT_TMS,
max(se.sess_exec_end_tms)  as SESS_EXEC_END_TMS from sess_exec se where se.sess_exec_st=2 group by sess_id

object.customQuery:
SELECT B.SESS_ID AS SESS_ID
,  C.WKF_EXEC_ID AS WKF_EXEC_ID
FROM wkf_master A
inner join sess_master B  ON  A.WKF_ID = B.WKF_ID 
inner join WKF_EXEC C  on A.WKF_ID = C.WKF_ID
where
C.WKF_EXEC_ST = '$$WKF_STARTED_STATUS' and
  TO_CHAR(C.WKF_EXEC_STRT_TMS,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ='$$$SESSSTARTTIME' AND upper( A.WKF_CD) = upper('$$PMWorkflowRunInstanceName')

SELECT WKF_MASTER.WKF_ID, SESS_MASTER.SESS_ID, SESS_PARM.PARM_CD, SESS_PARM.PARM_VAL, WKF_EXEC.WKF_EXEC_ID, SESS_MASTER.SESS_CD, SESS_EXEC.SESS_EXEC_ID, WKF_MASTER.WKF_FLD
FROM
 SESS_PARM, SESS_MASTER, SESS_EXEC, WKF_EXEC ,WKF_MASTER
WHERE
WKF_MASTER.WKF_ID = WKF_EXEC.WKF_ID
AND SESS_EXEC.WKF_EXEC_ID = WKF_EXEC.WKF_EXEC_ID
AND WKF_MASTER.WKF_ID = SESS_MASTER.wkf_ID
AND SESS_MASTER.SESS_ID = SESS_EXEC.SESS_ID
AND SESS_PARM.SESS_ID = SESS_MASTER.SESS_ID
AND upper(WKF_MASTER.WKF_CD) =  upper('$$PMWorkflowRunInstanceName')
AND WKF_EXEC.WKF_EXEC_ST = '$$WKF_STARTED_STATUS'
AND  TO_CHAR(WKF_EXEC.WKF_EXEC_STRT_TMS,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ='$$$SESSSTARTTIME'

Union 
SELECT WKF_MASTER.WKF_ID,SESS_MASTER.SESS_ID, 
SESS_PARM.PARM_CD, 
SESS_PARM.PARM_VAL, 
Null, 
SESS_MASTER.SESS_CD, 
null,
WKF_MASTER.WKF_FLD
FROM
SESS_PARM, SESS_MASTER, WKF_MASTER
where 
WKF_MASTER.WKF_ID = SESS_MASTER.wkf_ID
AND SESS_PARM.SESS_ID = SESS_MASTER.SESS_ID
AND WKF_MASTER.WKF_CD = '$$GLOBAL_WF_NAME'

SELECT A.WKF_ID AS WKF_ID,
	MAX(B.WKF_EXEC_ID) AS WKF_EXEC_ID_PREV
FROM WKF_MASTER A
LEFT OUTER JOIN WKF_EXEC B ON
	A.WKF_ID = B.WKF_ID AND
	B.WKF_EXEC_ST = '$$WKF_SUCCEEDED_STATUS'
WHERE upper(A.WKF_CD) =  upper('$$PMWorkflowRunInstanceName')
GROUP BY A.WKF_ID
